description: Search every LACCD course and program across all 9 colleges from your terminal — with cross-college comparison, prerequisite chains, and offline search the per-college web catalog can't do.

novel_features.name: Cross-college course comparison
novel_features.description: Compare the same subject+number across the LACCD colleges you've synced — units, transfer status, and prerequisite count side by side.

novel_features.name: Subject browse
novel_features.description: List every distinct subject prefix you've synced with course counts, and pull all courses for one subject across colleges (e.g. 'courses subjects ACCTG').

novel_features.name: Mirror coverage check
novel_features.description: Report how complete the local catalog mirror is per college — synced row counts vs the API's reported totals — before you trust offline search.

novel_features.name: Prerequisite chain
novel_features.description: Walk a course's structured requisite blocks and print its prerequisite / advisory / corequisite chain with course codes and titles.

novel_features.name: District catalog stats
novel_features.description: Aggregate the synced course store into per-college counts, units distribution, and transfer-status share — a district-wide view no per-college page provides.
